name: Emerson Electric
old_description: Manufactures electrical components, automation systems, and industrial equipment.
about:
Emerson Electric was founded in 1890 in St. Louis, Missouri. The company began as a manufacturer of electrical components and has grown into a global provider of automation systems and industrial equipment.

Today Emerson produces a broad portfolio of automation technologies, including process control systems, discrete automation solutions, final control products such as valves and actuators, measurement instrumentation, test and measurement platforms, and safety and productivity tools. The company operates a global support network and emphasizes industrial software and AI-driven analytics.

Emerson serves mission-critical sectors including power generation, liquified natural gas, life sciences, chemical processing, mining, and oil and gas. Its customers range from utilities and refineries to pharmaceutical manufacturers and industrial facilities.

The company cites its 135-plus years of innovation and a purpose-driven culture as key differentiators, aiming to deliver advanced automation that runs essential industries worldwide.
